instruction: Candid outdoor close-up photograph taken at a sunny waterfront pier with a clear blue sky. In the foreground on the right side, the smiling man in sunglasses and a blue waffle-knit shirt (R1) grins widely directly at the camera. Behind him on the left, the young girl in a pink ruffled top (R3) piggybacks on his back, wrapping her arms securely around his shoulders while looking off-camera to the right with a gentle expression. The background shows calm blue water stretching to the horizon under bright, warm afternoon sunlight.
